One passenger sits front, two in back; two passengers can sit in back if only two booked

blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours from Oakland County International Airport and other locations, including custom and holiday night flights. Flight training programs are offered for private, commercial, and instrument pilot ratings using Robinson R22 and R44 helicopters. Special events include aerial photography, video, and unique celebratory drops.
